whatThisIs: Read an X12 271 eligibility response without sending it anywhere. The reader turns coverage, plan identifiers, benefit amounts, percentages, dates, service types and network status into a plain summary and a checkable table.
whenToUse: Use this after receiving a 271 from a payer or clearinghouse and before quoting benefits. Raw codes remain beside project-authored labels so you can verify what the file actually says.
inputs: One X12 271 005010X279A1 text file, or a response pasted into the page, up to 50 MB. The response remains in the browser tab.
output: A coverage and benefit summary, every EB benefit line with its raw codes and dates, response error counts, and full or redacted CSV downloads. Redacted downloads mask names and member IDs.

example.result: 1 active person reported across 3 benefit lines.
